{{Quote|Thank you. One, two, three, four.|This droid|<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>}}
This '[[LEP servant droid/Legends|''LEP servant droid''']] was stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] worked for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when she held a party for Senator [[Aang/Legends|Aang]] and helped her set the main table. When [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] came back to the party with [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruit]], this droid set the garnish on the [[Jogan fruitcake/Legends|cake]] and handed it to the [[Unidentified baker droid/Legends|baker droid]] so that he could present it.
